about: Open-source starters to remix (v0.20). Every entry was checked for a permissive license (MIT, MIT-style or CC0) before it was listed; GPL and unlicensed projects are left out. 'remix: true' means the whole repository is small enough to copy into a new project; the others are big collections you browse and borrow from. Credit stays with the authors: keep their LICENSE file when you remix. See docs/STARTERS.md.

items.summary: The sliding-number puzzle in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Small, readable, easy to restyle into your own puzzle.
try: Change it to letters and make words

items.title: Phaser + Vite template
items.summary: The official Phaser 3 starter: a boot scene, a menu, a game scene and hot reload. The usual base for a 2D pixel game.

Add a title screen with music

items.title: melonJS boilerplate
items.summary: A ready-made melonJS project for tile-map games: load a level made in Tiled and walk around it.
try: Draw a first level in Tiled

items.title: PixiJS open games
items.summary: Complete, polished small games from the PixiJS team (a bubble shooter, a match-3 puzzle) with menus and sound.
try: Reskin the puzzle with our own art

items.title: LittleJS examples
items.summary: A tiny, fast engine for pixel games with many short examples: a breakout, a platformer, a puzzle, particles.

items.title: KAPLAY examples
items.summary: A friendly JavaScript game library made for beginners, with a playground of examples you can copy one by one.

items.title: Godot demo projects
items.summary: Official Godot demos for 2D and 3D: platformers, physics, pathfinding, UI. Borrow one folder as your starting point.

items.title: three.js examples
items.summary: Hundreds of 3D examples in the browser: cameras, lights, models, physics. Pick one and build around it.

items.summary: The same to-do app written in many frameworks. A clear way to see how an app is put together, then grow your own.

items.title: Expo phone app
items.summary: Make a real iPhone and Android app in JavaScript. One command creates a starter with tabs and screens.

items.title: HTML5 Boilerplate

items.title: Astro site templates

items.title: Kenney game art
